yontem.ne: Self-improving recursive language model framework for coding and long-running autonomous tasks
yontem.alinti: Prime Intellect released Prime Agent, an open-source coding harness that uses a self-improving Recursive Language Model (RLM) framework.

akis.ne: Prime Agent harness ile Opus 5 modelinin ARC AGI 3 skoru değerlendirildi
akis.alinti: One harness took Opus 5 from 30% to 95% on the ARC AGI 3 scale.

akis.ne: Harness'ın çalışma sırasında kendi prompt, bellek ve görevlerini yeniden yazarak kendini geliştirdiği açıklandı
akis.alinti: While it's running it could rewrite its own prompts, memory, and its tasks and modifies its own harness for self-improvement.
